description: Région des Pays de la Loire: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région des Pays de la Loire. Coverage: Région des Pays de la Loire. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Arrêts, horaires et circuits des lignes de transports en commun en Pay; Lignes, arrêts et horaires théorique du réseau de transport ( GTFS et ; Lignes, arrêts et horaires théorique du réseau de transport ( GTFS - N. Formats seen: GTFS, NETEX, SIRI, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
